generationRules: All unpublished topics use one model-planned local React pipeline; no topic keyword routing, preset project controls, step count or mandatory viewport pair.
legacyCompatibility: Existing published v1 artifacts retain their runtime, checks and workspaces; retired quicksort generation is removed.
runtimeBoundary: Local React App.jsx/styles.css; no backend, external APIs or extra dependencies. Unsupported delivery formats must be rejected rather than silently substituted.
modelCallBaseline: One plan + one existing plan review + one build per step. Existing bounded repair calls only; no new review phase.
repairChanges: Reject missing requirement coverage with explicit IDs
Pass rejected complete candidates and current check contracts to repairs
Preserve schema-invalid model output privately for repair
Support standard browser ARIA roles, including lists and tables

knownLimitations: Successful runtime checks prove the generated checks pass, not that every label faithfully captures every natural-language requirement.

Reading examples exposed weak semantic coverage: group totals do not prove every section has content; a visible element does not prove nonempty text. Generic prompt guidance was tightened, but this does not constitute a semantic correctness guarantee.

The multi-step todo example repeatedly failed plan or cumulative execution validation. No failed candidate was published. Latest attempt confused the list container count with the list item count; no todo-specific rule was introduced.
